intent.goal: search gmail messages in trass workspace mentioning maker

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
u.page_id,
u.workspace,
u.database_name,
u.title,
u.created_time,
g.subject,
g.sender_name,
g.sender_email,
g.body_snippet,
g.message_content,
g.email_date
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%maker%'
    OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%maker%'
    OR g.message_content LIKE '%maker%'
    OR g.sender_name LIKE '%maker%'
    OR g.sender_email LIKE '%maker%'
)
ORDER BY g.email_date DESC
LIMIT 1200

The modification has been implemented as shown in the images below. 15 mm Project Box – The thickness on the overlapping side will be controlled at 15 mm. The opposite side (without overlap) will be adjusted to 14 mm to ensure the total box thickness does not exceed 15 mm. Request to remove the cut at the flap of project box – it can be done. See attached Video. (Sorry, it is from China factory, they speak Mondrian.) But you can tell the issue is resolved. 😊             The full set of Kit Box and project Box White sample to be ready by next week.   Disc Project The felt and metal ring are only substitutes used for the packing trial. We will follow the approved components for actual production. We noted your preference to have the sticker applied onto the felt before shipment; however, we recommend allowing the customer to apply the label themselves. This is because the adhesive may become excessively sticky after long transportation and exposure to high temperatures inside the container. For this reason, we have prepared a white sample for your review and comments. Bat Project Bat Felt – Noted that the bat felt shape has been revised. We have already sent it for your approval. Rod – 3.0 mm, 3.8 mm, and 4.0 mm diameter rods have been sent for your review and comments. Sticky Bomb For the comment below – would you like the double-sided adhesive tape to cover the entire circular surfaces on both sides?                For the comment below – since there is a hole at the center, the adhesive needs to be split into two parts, resulting in four pieces of tape. If you prefer to have only three pieces, the side adhesive will be applied on just one side. Please reconfirm if this is your intended arrangement. Suction cup – to be discussed tonight. Sleep Cap ·          Adhesive tape is missing - we will add a 38–40 mm double-sided adhesive tape to secure it to the inside of the cap. ·          White thread length – we should follow the information on the “Supplies V2” which is 840cm +/-10cm Kit Card Paper Thickness: You requested 0.3 mm (360 gsm). However, we recommend using 300 gsm (approximately 0.336 mm after double-sided lamination), which will achieve a similar overall thickness.                       Sorry for the long message.
